literature_notes: All four ledger lines (L1–L4) describe N-terminal Myc or CFP tags on full-length ORAI2. The authoritative topology landmarks place the ORAI2 N-terminus (residues 1–65) in the intracellular compartment; ORAI2 has no signal peptide and both termini are cytoplasmic. The two extracellular loops (ECL1: 80–93; ECL2: 172–195) are not addressed by any ledger line. No ledger line reports a tolerated insertion on the extracellular face of ORAI2, so zero sites qualify. The N-terminal tags are recorded in other_positions as intracellular. L3 names no residue and is consistent with the same N-terminal placement used in L1/L4 (pCruz Myc / pCMV-myc vectors); it adds no independent position information.

literature_other_positions.note: Myc tag placed at the N-terminus of full-length Orai2 (insert_after_residue=0); residues 1–65 are intracellular per topology landmarks, so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular space.
N-terminally CFP-tagged ORAI2 construct; same cytoplasmic N-terminus (residues 1–65 intracellular), tag is on the intracellular face.
cMyc tag explicitly placed at the N-terminus of the ORAI2 ORF in pCMV-myc; N-terminus is intracellular (residues 1–65), so the tag is cytoplasmic.
